(J Trauma Acute Care Surg. 2026;101: 129-135. Copyright © 2026 Wolters Kluwer Health, Inc. All rights reserved.).

■ Original English Abstract:
Necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) is a life-threatening intestinal inflammatory disease in preterm infants. Inositol hexakisphosphate kinase 1 (IP6K1) regulates platelet polyphosphate (polyP) homeostasis, yet its roles in NEC remain unclear. This study aimed to investigate the regulatory mechanism of platelet IP6K1 in neutrophil-platelet aggregate (NPA) formation and NEC pathogenesis, and to evaluate the therapeutic potential of IP6K1 inhibition. In mitotic mast cells, periodic cortical waves emerge before spindle assembly with wave periods that are proportional to cell size. Here, we investigate the mechanisms that govern cortical wave scaling and examine the consequence of wave perturbation on mitotic spindle size scaling. We find that the periods of mitotic waves are regulated by the turnover of phosphatidylinositol 3,4-bisphosphate [PI(3,4)P2] on the plasma membrane, which depends on inositol polyphosphate-4-phosphatase type II (INPP4B). On the basis of these findings, we propose a cell size-sensing mechanism in which cortical waves act like sonar waves, adjusting their timing and propagation based on the shuttling of signaling proteins between the cell cortex and intracellular organelles. This rapid communication scheme allows the cell to adjust spindle scaling dynamically, ensuring accurate cell division.

Infected skin defects persist in a pathological state characterized by dysregulation of the immune microenvironment and impaired bioenergetics, requiring coordinated treatment strategies to remold them. Currently developing therapies with coordinated effects are often hampered by incomplete targets, high complexity, and limited clinical performance, underscoring the need for minimalist yet effective strategies that integrate both targets. Here, we address this challenge by designing a two-component system, the polyphosphate-gallic acid (polyP-GA) complex, with high biocompatibility and adaptability to different material forms (e.g., solution, spray, hydrogel, and paste). This work demonstrates that the minimalist therapeutic design, built on the synergistic pairing of biocompatible but otherwise subtherapeutic agents polyP and GA, can effectively break the cycle of infection-driven regenerative arrest, achieving high performance in promoting the healing of infected skin defects.

Here, we present an amplification byproduct-induced nanozyme suppression (ABINS) strategy that uses amplification byproducts as functional signals for colorimetric ctDNA detection. We report the abiotic synthesis of structurally modified, RNase-resistant oligonucleotides with phosphodiester backbones from non-activated mononucleotides of adenosine monophosphate (AMP) and uridine monophosphate (UMP), and pyrophosphate linked D-ribose-5'-phosphate polymers under simulated wet-dry cycling conditions. Evidence for polymerization was obtained in UV-vis and IR spectra. SAXS suggests aggregates in solution of approximately 120 nucleotide and ribose phosphate units.

The chemical space of methane control strategies is still underexplored. Most known methanogenesis inhibitors target methanogenic archaeal enzymes. However, interference with the exchange of syntrophic electron carriers (H2 or formate) in methanogenic systems presents an additional target for methane control. Here, we show that hypophosphite (H2PO2-), an inorganic formate analogue, is a potent and selective inhibitor of syntrophic methanogenesis versus primary fermentation in rice field sediments and cattle rumens. ■ 日本語タイトル: ポリリン酸によって駆動される普遍的なヌクレオシドからヌクレオシド-5'-三リン酸への酵素カスケード

■ 関連タグ: ミトコンドリア・代謝
■ 著者:

ヌクレオシド-5'-三リン酸 (NTP) は核酸の重要な構成要素ですが、最終的な 5'-三リン酸化反応の収率が低いため、化学合成の効率が制限されます。本研究では、すべての標準的な rNTP および dNTP のヌクレオシドから NTP への変換を可能にする、わずか 2 つの酵素が関与する酵素カスケード反応を紹介します。このカスケードは、コスト効率の高いポリリン酸ナトリウム (polyP) によって駆動される単一のワンポット操作で使用されます。キイロショウジョウバエ由来の広域スペクトルのデオキシヌクレオシド キナーゼ (Dm-dNK) は、ATP を用いたヌクレオシドをヌクレオシド-5'-一リン酸 (NMP) に変換します。エリシペロトリカエ科細菌由来のポリリン酸キナーゼ ファミリー 2、クラス III (EbPPK) は、Dm-dNK に必要な ATP をリサイクルし、ポリ P 依存性反応で NMP を NTP に変換します。重要なのは、触媒ATPは微量（0.0001当量以下）のみ必要であるということです。正規の NTP に加えて、カスケードはリボース修飾および塩基修飾された NTP 類似体を生成できます。これは、4 つの 2'-フルオロ-2'-dNTP および核酸塩基として 2,6-ジアミノプリンを持つヌクレオチドを含む、11 の修飾ヌクレオチドのセットの合成を通じて実証されます。 mRNA 治療薬の必須成分である N1-メチル-ΨTP (m1ΨTP) の生成がミリグラムスケールで実証されている。

■ Original English Abstract:
Nucleoside-5'-triphosphates (NTPs) are important building blocks for nucleic acids, but the efficiency of their chemical synthesis is limited by the low yield of the final 5'-triphosphorylation reaction. Here, we present an enzymatic cascade reaction involving just two enzymes that enable nucleosides-to-NTPs conversion for all canonical rNTPs and dNTPs. The cascade is used in a single one-pot operation driven by cost-efficient sodium polyphosphate (polyP). The broad-spectrum deoxynucleoside kinase (Dm-dNK) from Drosophila melanogaster converts nucleosides into nucleoside-5'-monophosphates (NMPs) using ATP. The polyphosphate kinase family 2, class III (EbPPK) from an Erysipelotrichaceae bacterium simultaneously recycles ATP required by Dm-dNK and converts the NMPs to NTPs in a polyP-dependent reaction. Importantly, only trace amounts of catalytic ATP (0.0001 equivalents or less) are required. In addition to canonical NTPs, the cascade can generate ribose- and base-modified NTP analogues. This is demonstrated through the synthesis of a set of eleven modified nucleotides, including the four 2'-fluoro-2'-dNTPs and nucleotides with 2,6-diaminopurine as the nucleobase. ■ 日本語タイトル: Usefulness of PPi levels to interpret variants of unknown significance and incomplete penetrant alleles in the ABCC6 gene.
■ Original Title: Usefulness of PPi levels to interpret variants of unknown significance and incomplete penetrant alleles in the ABCC6 gene.
■ 関連タグ: ミトコンドリア・代謝
■ 著者: 
■ 発行年: 2026 (Source: PubMed)
■ 原著論文リンク(PDF/記事): https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42229705/

■ 日本語要約:
Pseudoxanthoma elasticum is usually caused by biallelic pathogenic variants in ABCC6, leading to reduced ATP transport and decreased levels of circulating calcification inhibitor inorganic pyrophosphate. Variants of unknown significance and incomplete penetrant variants complicate genetic counseling. This study assessed whether plasma pyrophosphate levels can aid in interpreting their pathogenicity or penetrance. Blood samples were collected from 90 patients, 139 carriers, and 31 healthy volunteers. Demographic, clinical, imaging, and biochemical data were collected. ABCC6 variants were classified according to Sherloc guidelines into (likely) pathogenic, variant of unknown significance, or variant with incomplete penetrance. The latter two were further classified as 'Likely causal' or 'No arguments for causality'. Participants were grouped accordingly for comparative analysis of plasma pyrophosphate levels. Plasma pyrophosphate levels were significantly decreased in patients compared to carriers and controls. However, large variability persisted within cohorts and individual families. No differences in plasma pyrophosphate levels were observed between the variant types. In carriers, no significant differences were observed between presumed penetrant versus non-penetrant variants or between presumed causal versus non-causal variants of unknown significance. Although pyrophosphate levels are reduced in patients, ABCC6 variant classification does not affect pyrophosphate levels. Our results show that plasma pyrophosphate levels have no added value for interpreting causality of variants of unknown significance or penetrance of incomplete penetrant alleles in ABCC6.

ポリリン酸は、すべての生細胞に存在する、進化的に保存されたリン酸残基の直鎖です。細菌は、エネルギーとリン酸の貯蔵、タンパク質の折り畳み、ストレスへの適応のために、ストレスと飢餓下でポリリン酸を蓄積します。感染中に細菌は宿主の反応を損なう可能性のあるポリリン酸を放出しますが、正確なメカニズムは依然として解明されていません。この研究では、レジオネラ症患者の気管支肺胞洗浄液、単独で培養したレジオネラ・ニューモフィラ、またはC57BL/6Jマウスの骨髄由来マクロファージ（BMDM）の感染中に、ポリリン酸塩が上昇することが判明した。長鎖細菌型ポリリン酸の存在下または非存在下で共インキュベートした感染した BMDM の RNA シーケンスを実行した。約 500 個の差次的に発現する遺伝子の中で、高度に発現する遺伝子の中で Il12b (p40) が最も強い抑制を示した。 IL-12p40タンパク質の放出は、長鎖ポリリン酸（〜Pi700）によって用量依存的に減少しましたが、短鎖の哺乳類型ポリリン酸（〜Pi70）によっては減少しませんであった。これは、自然免疫シグナル伝達を標的とする特異的な細菌機構を示している。対照的に、インフラマソームの活性化によって処理され、IL-12 と機能的に相乗作用する IL-18 は、一貫して抑制されませんであった。ポリリン酸は主に LPS/TLR4 シグナル伝達を阻害し、レジオネラ菌誘導性 IL-12 は MyD88 経路に依存しますが、TRIF には依存しませんであった。以前はポリリン酸生物学に関与するとされていた RAGE と P2Y1 は、IL-12 抑制には必要ありませんであった。しかし、PI3K/AKTシグナル伝達はポリリン酸の効果を媒介するようであり、この効果はPI3K阻害剤であるLY294002、コパンリシブ、エガネリシブによって逆転した。最後に、長鎖ポリリン酸は、L.ニューモフィラまたはLPSに曝露されたヒト単球由来マクロファージからもIL-12放出を抑制した。要約すると、我々の発見は、長鎖細菌ポリリン酸によるIL-12の選択的阻害を特定し、これらの分子が防御自然免疫応答を抑制できる細菌エフェクターとして機能することを示唆している。

■ Original English Abstract:
Polyphosphates are evolutionarily conserved linear chains of phosphate residues present in all living cells. Bacteria accumulate polyphosphates under stress and starvation for energy and phosphate storage, protein folding, and stress adaptation. During infection, bacteria release polyphosphates that may impair host responses, although the exact mechanisms remain elusive. In this study, polyphosphates were found to be elevated in bronchoalveolar lavage fluids from patients with Legionnaires' disease, in Legionella pneumophila cultured alone, or during infection of bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMDMs) from C57BL/6J mice. We performed RNA-sequencing of infected BMDMs co-incubated with or without long-chain, bacterial-type polyphosphates. Among nearly 500 differentially expressed genes, Il12b (p40) showed the strongest suppression among highly expressed genes. IL-12p40 protein release was dose-dependently reduced by long-chain polyphosphates (~Pi700), but not by short-chain, mammalian-type polyphosphates (~Pi70), indicating a specific bacterial mechanism targeting innate immune signaling. In contrast, IL-18, processed by inflammasome activation and synergizing functionally with IL-12, was not consistently suppressed. Polyphosphates predominantly inhibited LPS/TLR4 signaling, with Legionella-induced IL-12 relying on the MyD88 pathway, but not TRIF. RAGE and P2Y1, previously implicated in polyphosphate biology, were not required for IL-12 suppression. However, PI3K/AKT signaling appeared to mediate polyphosphate effects, which were reversed by the PI3K inhibitors, LY294002, copanlisib, and eganelisib. Finally, long-chain polyphosphates suppressed IL-12 release also from human monocyte-derived macrophages exposed to L. pneumophila or LPS. In summary, our findings identify a selective inhibition of IL-12 by long-chain bacterial polyphosphates, suggesting that these molecules act as bacterial effectors capable of suppressing protective innate immune responses.

Micronutrient deficiencies remain prevalent among preschool-aged children (PSC) in India. In tauopathies, a specific class of neurodegenerative disorders, tau protein aggregation and mitochondrial dysfunction are pathological processes interconnected in a self-reinforcing cycle. In fact, tau fibrils impair mitochondrial transport, bioenergetics, and quality control, while mitochondrial dysregulation causes tau post-translational modifications, detachment from neurons, and aggregation. Understanding these biochemical and nutritional interactions may support the development of novel therapeutic approaches and provide effective preventive strategies to mitigate the risk of neurodegeneration in aging populations. Charge-converting nanocarriers can mitigate this issue by masking positive charges during circulation; however, they remain constrained by inefficient endosomal escape. To overcome this limiting step, we designed enzyme-responsive, charge-converting fusogenic liposomes that combine polyphosphate coatings with DOPE/DOTAP-based fusogenic liposomes. The polyphosphate suppresses cationic charge during circulation, while alkaline-phosphatase-mediated dephosphorylation restores the cationic charge required for membrane fusion. Liposomes were systematically characterized for size, zeta-potential, and phosphate-release-induced charge conversion. Their interaction with Caco-2 cells was mechanistically investigated using confocal microscopy, flow cytometry, and Förster resonance energy transfer, demonstrating the existence of a fusion-driven uptake. Upon loading with plasmid DNA, the most fusogenic formulations enabled a rapid onset of GFP expression consistent with direct cytosolic access. Overall, this work provides a mechanistic investigation of polyphosphate-coated fusogenic liposomes and demonstrates that enzyme-triggered charge conversion can be coupled to membrane fusion to facilitate cytosolic delivery.

■ Original English Abstract:

■ Original English Abstract:
Polyphosphate (polyP) is an ancient, evolutionarily conserved inorganic polymer found in all domains of life. PolyP functions in energy storage, metal chelation, phosphate buffering, and regulation of fundamental physiological processes such as blood coagulation, bone mineralisation, and mitochondrial energy metabolism. Here, we summarize current knowledge of polyP-metabolizing enzymes. In prokaryotes, polyP synthesis is primarily catalysed by polyphosphate kinases (PPK1 and PPK2), which synthesize long-chain polymers from adenosine triphosphate (ATP) or guanosine triphosphate (GTP); notable these enzymes are absent in higher eukaryotes. In yeast, the vacuolar transporter chaperone (VTC) complex functions as a polyP polymerase-translocase, coupling synthesis with vacuolar import. In mammals, the enzymatic machinery responsible for polyP formation remains elusive, although mitochondrial F1F0-ATP synthase and inositol pyrophosphate signalling have been implicated. PolyP degradation is mediated by two major enzyme families: exo- and endopolyphosphatases. Members of these families - including exopolyphosphatases (PPX) and endopolyphosphatases (PPN) in yeast and bacteria as well as Nudix hydrolases and h-Prune in mammals - play key roles in maintaining intracellular phosphate homeostasis and regulating the dynamic turnover of polyP. Defining the molecular pathways of polyP synthesis and degradation will reveal novel therapeutic targets in infection, thrombosis, and metabolic disease.

■ Original English Abstract:

■ Original English Abstract:
In osteoporotic fracture-related infection (FRI), the coordinated bone healing is compromised by cortical bone lysis and persistent bacterial colonization. Current treatments primarily focus on infection control, but fail to preserve bone microarchitecture or restore disrupted healing cascade, particularly in fragile osteoporotic bone. The stringent response is a conserved stress-adaptation program in bacteria, mediated by the alarmones (p)ppGpp that reprogram transcription, translation, and metabolism. This mini-review surveys mechanistic, physiological, and evolutionary facets of alarmone singnaling across two classes of RelA/SpoT homologue (RSH) enzymes: multidomain-containing long RSHs and small alarmone synthetases/hydrolases (SAS/SAH). Calcium pyrophosphate deposition (CPPD) disease is an inflammatory arthritis prevalent in elderly individuals. Spinal CPPD is uncommon, and presentation can vary widely with common clinical and radiographic mimics. We identified 9 cases of lumbar and 1 case of thoracic spinal CPPD (age range: 63-85 years; 5 male, 5 female) at our institution over a 10-year period. All presented with pain (90% chronic, 10% acute); 4 had prior instrumentation and 1 had prior trauma. CPPD was not clinically suspected in any case. Preoperative imaging diagnoses include central canal stenosis, neuroforaminal narrowing, septic arthropathy, synovial cyst, degeneration, and epidural mass/abscess. Intraoperatively, a spinal cyst was most often described. Although clinical presentations are variable, wider recognition of this rare disease among neuropathologists receiving spinal specimens may provide earlier diagnosis. Accurate pathologic diagnosis can improve identification, refine clinical suspicion, and facilitate management. Improved identification, particularly in elderly patients and those with prior trauma/instrumentation, will promote appropriate therapy and management.

This signaling mechanism can be driven by inositol pyrophosphate messengers, which can convert a prephosphorylated protein to the corresponding pyrophosphoprotein. Endogenous protein pyrophosphorylation influences various cellular processes and signaling pathways, including the regulation of rRNA synthesis and the modulation of vesicular trafficking. Herein, we will summarize the current detection and analysis methods that have established the occurrence of pyrophosphorylation. These methods have also been used to explore the effects of pyrophosphorylation on protein structure and function. Putative mechanisms for the regulation of this intriguing, understudied modification will be discussed. Finally, the future needs for this developing area of signal transduction research are highlighted.

<title>Abstract</title>  <p>Conventional neuroscience generally assumes that metabolic arrest leads to rapid and irreversible dissipation of organized neural activity. However, clinical and experimental observations have repeatedly reported transient episodes of pronounced neural synchronization—most notably high-amplitude Gamma-band (30–100 Hz) activity—during the early agonal interval following circulatory collapse. Under these conditions, Zn– polyphosphate–short-chain hyaluronan complexes progressively consolidate into mechanically stabilized, highly porous condensates. This framework reframes biological death as a non-equilibrium material transition and provides testable predictions grounded in measurable chemical and physical parameters.</p>

■ 日本語タイトル: ケモインフォマティクスに基づいた、酸性条件下におけるフィコシアニンの食品グレードのアニオン安定剤の発見
■ Original Title: Chemoinformatics-guided discovery of food-grade anionic stabilizers for phycocyanin under acidic conditions
■ 著者: 
■ 発行年: 2026 (Source: PPR)
■ 原著論文リンク(PDF/記事): https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.05.25.727568

■ 日本語要約:
フィコシアニン (PC) は、機能性飲料に使用される主な天然青色色素ですが、酸性条件 (pH ≈ 3) では急速に色を失い、凝集します。安定剤の実験的スクリーニングは費用がかかり、組み合わせが困難です。今回我々は、ケモインフォマティクスフレームワーク（記述子ベースのQSPR、化学事前ヒューリスティック、仮想スクリーニング）を開発する。このフレームワークは、3ラウンドの委託スクリーニング（48化合物、ヒット率6％）から学習して、安定剤の有効性を分子構造から直接予測する。この真に小さなデータ領域 (ポジティブ 3 つ) では、10 個の RDKit 記述子と 11 個のドメインエキスパート電荷/ポリマー特徴から構築された LightGBM 分類器は、leave-one-out AUC 0.73 を達成しましたが、これは単一特徴の電荷密度ベースライン (AUC 0.67) をわずかに上回るだけであった。 LOO 感度は、しきい値 0.5 で 1/3 であった。陰イオンタイプの事前予測をエンコードする相補的な化学事前ヒューリスティックは、両方を大幅に上回り、AUC 0.95 に達した。これは、明示的な化学知識が、このデータセットサイズでは記述子ベースの ML が容易に回復できない情報を捕捉していることを示している。 QSPR の SHAP 分析により、主要な特徴として単位あたりの有効負電荷密度、対数分子量、ポリリン酸の同一性、および官能基密度 (合わせて平均 |SHAP| の ≈97%) が特定され、事前に提供されることなく静電複合体形成メカニズムが回復されました。一般に安全と認められる（GRAS）食品添加物 30 種類の仮想スクリーニングでは、ピロリン酸ナトリウム 10 水和物とヘキサメタリン酸ナトリウム (SHMP) が主導で、どちらも P ≈ 0.99 のピロリン酸ファミリーと、ヒューリスティックでさらにフラグが付けられたフィチン酸ナトリウム (IP□) が候補に挙がりましたが、記述子モデルでは P = 0.045 で下位ランク付けされました。 pH 3、46 °C での 7 日間の実験検証では、SHMP 2:1 (78.1 ± 11.3% の色保持率)、TSPP 2:1 (54.1 ± 10.6%)、および IP□ 1:1 (52.7 ± 9.0%) が確認されましたが、三成分 IP□ + STPP の組み合わせは 83.8 ± 11.9% に達し、すべてを上回りました。単一成分配合。ゼータ電位測定により、保護の主な原因は静電であることが示されました (ゼータと CR□□□の間のピアソン r = -0.82; n = 24; p = 1 × 10□ □)。このフレームワーク、データセット、コードは、他の酸に敏感な食品着色料の安定剤の発見を加速し、率直な小規模データのベンチマークを提供するためにリリースされました。

■ Original English Abstract:
Phycocyanin (PC) is the principal natural blue pigment used in functional beverages, but it rapidly loses color and aggregates under acidic conditions (pH ≈ 3). Experimental screening of stabilizers is costly and combinatorially intractable. Here we develop a chemoinformatics framework — descriptor-based QSPR, a chemistry-prior heuristic, and virtual screening — that learns from three rounds of commissioned screening (48 compounds, 6% hit rate) to predict stabilizer efficacy directly from molecular structure. In this genuinely small-data regime (3 positives), a LightGBM classifier built from 10 RDKit descriptors and 11 domain-expert charge/polymer features attained a leave-one-out AUC of 0.73, only marginally above a single-feature charge-density baseline (AUC 0.67); LOO sensitivity was 1/3 at threshold 0.5. A complementary chemistry-prior heuristic encoding anion-type priors substantially outperformed both, reaching AUC 0.95, indicating that explicit chemical knowledge captures information that descriptor-based ML cannot readily recover at this dataset size. SHAP analysis of the QSPR identified effective negative-charge density per unit, log molecular weight, polyphosphate identity, and functional-group density as the dominant features (jointly ≈97% of mean |SHAP|), recovering the electrostatic-complexation mechanism without it being supplied as a prior. Virtual screening of 30 generally recognized as safe (GRAS) food additives nominated the pyrophosphate family — led by sodium pyrophosphate decahydrate and sodium hexametaphosphate (SHMP), both at P ≈ 0.99 — and the heuristic additionally flagged sodium phytate (IP□), which the descriptor model under-ranked at P = 0.045. Experimental validation at pH 3 and 46 °C for 7 days confirmed SHMP 2:1 (78.1 ± 11.3% color retention), TSPP 2:1 (54.1 ± 10.6%) and IP□ 1:1 (52.7 ± 9.0%), while a ternary IP□ + STPP combination reached 83.8 ± 11.9%, surpassing all single-component formulations. ζ-Potential measurements indicated a predominantly electrostatic origin for the protection (Pearson r = −0.82 between ζ and CR□ □ □; n = 24; p = 1 × 10□ □). The framework, dataset and code are released to accelerate stabilizer discovery for other acid-sensitive food colorants and to provide a candid small-data benchmark.

■ 日本語タイトル: クエン酸塩とリン酸塩の乳化塩の比率が、水で洗い流した発酵乳から作られたチーズ類似物の特性に及ぼす影響
■ Original Title: Consequence of the ratio of citrate and phosphate emulsifying salts on the characteristics of cheese analogue made from water-flushing fermented milk
■ 著者: 
■ 発行年: 2026 (Source: AGR)
■ 原著論文リンク(PDF/記事): https://europepmc.org/article/AGR/IND609367432

■ 日本語要約:
クエン酸三ナトリウム (TSC) とポリリン酸ナトリウム (SPP) の比率 (3:1、2:1、1:1、1:2、1:3) が、乳製品加工の副産物である水洗発酵乳 (WFM) から作られたチーズ類似物の微細構造、テクスチャー、レオロジー特性および官能特性に及ぼす影響を調査した。 TSC/SPP 比が 1:2 に減少すると、チーズ類似物の食感と感覚特性が大幅に向上した。 TSC/SPP の比率が 1:2 の場合、チーズ類似品は最適な硬さ、弾力性、噛みごたえ、うまみ、受け入れやすさを備え、カゼインは緻密な三次元ネットワーク構造を形成した。レオロジー分析により、TSC/SPP比が1:2のチーズ類似品が安定したゲル系と良好な粘弾性を有することがさらに検証されました。しかし、TSC/SPP 比が 1:3 になった後は、過剰な乳化によりチーズ類似物の性能が弱まりました。この研究は、乳化塩が乳製品副産物 WFM を原料として使用する新規チーズ類似品の開発に不可欠であり、乳製品加工廃棄物の高価値利用に対する技術的サポートを提供することを示した。

■ Original English Abstract:
The consequence of the ratio of trisodium citrate (TSC) and sodium polyphosphate (SPP) (3:1, 2:1, 1:1, 1:2 and 1:3) on the microstructure, texture, rheological and sensory properties of cheese analogue made from water-flushing fermented milk (WFM), a by-product of dairy processing, was investigated. The texture and sensory properties of the cheese analogue was significantly enhanced with TSC/SPP ratio decreased to 1:2. At the ratio of TSC/SPP for 1:2, the cheese analogue had the optimal hardness, elasticity, chewiness, umami, and acceptability, while the casein formed dense three-dimensional network structure. Rheological analysis further verified that cheese analogue with TSC/SPP ratio of 1:2 had stable gel system and good viscoelasticity. However, after TSC/SPP ratio was 1:3, performance of the cheese analogue was weakened due to over-emulsification. This study exhibited that emulsifying salts were essential for the development of novel cheese analogues using dairy by-product WFM as raw material, providing the technical support for the high-value utilization of dairy processing wastes.

■ 日本語タイトル: 乾式肥料と液体のリンおよびカリウム肥料に対するトウモロコシと大豆の反応
■ Original Title: Corn and soybean response to dry versus liquid phosphorus and potassium fertilizers
■ 著者: 
■ 発行年: 2026 (Source: AGR)
■ 原著論文リンク(PDF/記事): https://europepmc.org/article/AGR/IND609457617

■ 日本語要約:
液体リン (P) およびカリウム (K) 肥料への関心が高まっており、多くの場合、乾燥粒状肥料よりも優れた性能が主張されている。トウモロコシ (Zea mays L.) と大豆 [Glycine max (L.) Merr.] の乾燥対液体 P および K に対する収量と組織栄養反応を比較した。圃場試験は 2021 年から 2024 年にかけて、トウモロコシ 8 サイトと大豆 6 サイトを含む 42 サイト年にわたり、作物ごとに別々の P のみ、K のみ、および P+K を組み合わせた試験で実施されました。各試験には、肥料なしのチェックと、供給源（乾燥対液体）と割合（半分対完全）の要因の組み合わせが含まれていました。三重過リン酸塩と塩酸カリは乾式肥料源であり，ポリリン酸アンモニウムとナチュールＫ燃料は液体肥料源であった。葉の栄養素は V11 ～ V12 (トウモロコシ) および R2 ～ R3 (大豆) 段階で分析され、収量は成熟時に測定されました。リンまたはカリウム欠乏土壌では、トウモロコシの収量は供給源によって異なりませんであった。ただし、フルレートではハーフレートに比べて収量が 5% ～ 13% 増加した。大豆の場合、単一栄養素試験では供給源とレートの影響は有意ではありませんでしたが、P+K 試験では、フルレートはハーフレートよりも収量が 9% ～ 10% 増加した。環境全体で、組織診断と一致した応答が得られます。組織-K は収量増加と一貫して関連していましたが、組織-P は一般的な贅沢なリン摂取の下では予測性が低かったです。全体として、液体ソースは、同等の速度で乾燥粒状ソースと比較して利点をもたらさなかった。ハーフレートの液体はフルレートの乾燥収量と一致せず、同時適用された P+K は単一栄養素の反応を反映した。配合や相乗効果ではなく、収量の差が比率に反映されます。結果は、収量を目標とする場合、配合ではなく土壌試験に基づく率を使用すること、および組織-P よりも作物反応の信頼性の高い季節指標として組織-K を使用することを強調している。

■ Original English Abstract:
Interest in liquid phosphorus (P) and potassium (K) fertilizers is increasing, often with claims of superior performance over dry‐granular sources. We compared yield and tissue‐nutrient responses of corn (Zea mays L.) and soybean [Glycine max (L.) Merr.] to dry versus liquid P and K. Field trials were conducted from 2021 to 2024 across 42 site‐years, including eight corn and six soybean sites, with separate P‐only, K‐only, and combined P+K trials for each crop. Each trial included a no‐fertilizer check and factorial combinations of source (dry vs. liquid) and rate (half vs. full). Triple superphosphate and muriate of potash were dry‐fertilizer sources, and ammonium polyphosphate and Nachurs K‐fuel were liquid‐fertilizer sources. Leaf nutrients were analyzed at V11–V12 (corn) and R2–R3 (soybean) stages, and yield was measured at maturity. In P‐ or K‐deficient soils, corn yield did not differ by sources; however, full‐rates increased yield by 5%–13% over half‐rates. For soybean, source and rate effects were not significant in single‐nutrient trials, whereas in P+K trials, full‐rates increased yield by 9%–10% over half‐rates. Across environments, yield responses aligned with tissue diagnostics; tissue‐K was consistently associated with yield gains, whereas tissue‐P was less predictive under common luxury P uptake. Overall, liquid sources provided no advantage over dry‐granular sources at equivalent rates. Half‐rate liquid did not match full‐rate dry yields, and co‐applied P+K mirrored single‐nutrient responses; yield differences reflected rate, not formulation or synergy. Results emphasize using soil‐test‐based rates, not formulation, when targeting yield, and tissue‐K as a more reliable in‐season indicator of crop response than tissue‐P.

■ 日本語タイトル: Dark CO  <sub>2</sub>  Fixation via the Ethylmalonyl-CoA Pathway Establishes Metabolic Parity: A Stoichiometric Basis for Compounding Ecosystem Shifts
■ Original Title: Dark CO  <sub>2</sub>  Fixation via the Ethylmalonyl-CoA Pathway Establishes Metabolic Parity: A Stoichiometric Basis for Compounding Ecosystem Shifts
■ 関連タグ: 環境・排水処理（ノイズ候補）
■ 著者: 
■ 発行年: 2026 (Source: PPR)
■ 原著論文リンク(PDF/記事): https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.26.747204

■ 日本語要約:
(日本語要約なし)

■ Original English Abstract:
A central challenge in microbial ecology is understanding how competing guilds coexist and why community structures unexpectedly drift away from theoretical steady states. While polyphosphate accumulation provides energy and redox buffering in many heterotrophs, how competing lineages occupying the same ecological niche without polyphosphate synthesis manage equivalent intracellular redox imbalances remains unposed. Using an enhanced biological phosphorus removal macrocosm, we integrated quantitative stoichiometry with metaproteomics to resolve alternative metabolic strategies that underpin cellular homeostasis in heterotrophs. We show that glycogen-accumulating organisms (GAOs) achieve baseline metabolic parity with polyphosphate-accumulating organisms (PAOs) through a parallel redox-buffering mechanism: heterotrophic CO  2 /HCO  3 − re-assimilation via the ethylmalonyl-CoA pathway. This inorganic carbon fixation couples structural carbon conservation with tight redox control, mitigating intracellular electron overflow and eliminating the long-assumed GAO bioenergetic inferiority. The bioenergetic efficiency of GAOs is further fortified by fine-tuned metabolic wiring, featuring energy-efficient high affinity acetate activation, ferredoxin-centered biochemistry, and energy-neutral polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHA) mobilization. Strikingly, minor formate co-feeding disrupted this established PAO–GAO parity. Stoichiometric simulations revealed that this formate supplementation creates an asymmetric bioenergetic niche that grants per-cycle energy gains exclusively to GAOs. Decoupled from hydraulic throughput, solids retention time control retains cells carrying accumulated intracellular inventory, translating subtle per-cycle stoichiometric edges into a multi-generational ratchet and drives a rapid community shift from PAO–GAO co-dominance to GAO dominance. By exposing limitations of traditional single-substrate and single-cycle steady-state models, our findings reveal how inorganic resource management and generational metabolic compounding govern community assembly in biomass-retaining microbial ecosystems.

■ 日本語タイトル: Decoupling Steric-Dependent Adsorption Mechanisms in "Covalent-Ionic" Dual-Orthogonal Crosslinked GO/CS Hydrogels for Efficient Dye Sequestration
■ Original Title: Decoupling Steric-Dependent Adsorption Mechanisms in "Covalent-Ionic" Dual-Orthogonal Crosslinked GO/CS Hydrogels for Efficient Dye Sequestration
■ 著者: 
■ 発行年: 2026 (Source: PPR)
■ 原著論文リンク(PDF/記事): https://doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.rs-10919089/v1

■ 日本語要約:
(日本語要約なし)

■ Original English Abstract:
<title>Abstract</title>  <p>Bulk hydrogel adsorbents show great promise in water remediation, yet overcoming the intrinsic contradiction between mechanical skeleton stability and high-density active sites remains a core challenge. Herein, a novel "covalent-ionic" dual-orthogonal crosslinking strategy based on sodium tripolyphosphate (TPP) and genipin was proposed to construct hierarchical mesoporous graphene oxide/chitosan (GO/CS) composite hydrogels. Compared to traditional highly toxic single-crosslinked systems, this strategy achieves robust spatial confinement of GO sheets while preserving abundant polar adsorption sites. By integrating comprehensive characterizations (SEM, BET, XRD, FT-IR, Raman, and XPS), the microscopic physicochemical synergistic adsorption mechanisms of the hydrogel toward planar methylene blue (MB) and bulky malachite green (MG) were systematically elucidated. The results suggest a strong steric-dependent interfacial behavior: the capture of MB primarily relies on face-to-face π-π conjugated stacking with the GO basal plane and localized charge transfer, whereas the adsorption of sterically hindered MG is dominantly driven by Coulombic electrostatic attraction and hydrogen bonding provided by deprotonated carboxyl and polar nitrogen sites. Furthermore, the hydrogel maintained over 80% of its retention capacity after five consecutive adsorption-desorption cycles without macroscopic structural deterioration or GO leakage. This study offers an engineering solution to the solid-liquid separation difficulties of powdered adsorbents and establishes a theoretical paradigm for steric-dependent confined adsorption in complex polymer networks.</p>

冬小麦の栄養価と組成に対するストルバイトの影響は、まだ十分に研究されていません。 1 年間の圃場実験では、2 つの小麦品種を用いた 3 つのリン施肥処理 (対照、過リン酸塩、ストルバイト) が比較されました。穀物の収量は品種間で大きな差はありませんでしたが、穀物のPとCu、およびわらKでは顕著な品種固有の変動が発生した。リン施肥は穀物のN、K、Mg、Na、およびいくつかの微量栄養素（Fe、Mn、Zn）に影響を与えました。ストルバイトは、Mg と Fe の濃度を大幅に増加させました。総AAおよび総EAAの値がシェヴィニヨンでより高いことが判明したため、真のタンパク質はアクティバスと比較してシェヴィニヨンの方が高かったが、粗繊維はアクティバスの方が高かった。 P 施肥では、CP、ADF、および CEL に有意な差が見つかりました。ストルバイト治療下の CP は、過リン酸塩治療下よりも約 13% 低く、対照よりも約 4% 低かった。リン施肥はまた、硫黄含有アミノ酸、特にシスチンとメチオニンの含有量、およびそれらのリジンに対する相対量（LYS = 100% として）を増加させました。シェヴィニヨンは、より高い総アミノ酸含有量と必須アミノ酸含有量を示した。全体として、ストルバイトは収量を維持し、特に Mg、Fe、一部のアミノ酸などの穀物の品質を向上させ、結果は酸性土壌での 1 シーズンに限られていたにもかかわらず、持続可能な肥料としての可能性を示した。

■ Original English Abstract:
The effects of struvite on the nutritional value and composition of winter wheat remain insufficiently explored. In a one-year field experiment, three phosphorus fertilization treatments (control, superphosphate, struvite) were compared using two wheat cultivars. Grain yield did not differ significantly between cultivars, but notable cultivar-specific variations occurred in grain P and Cu and in straw K. Phosphorus fertilization influenced grain N, K, Mg, Na, and several micronutrients (Fe, Mn, Zn). Struvite significantly increased Mg and Fe concentrations. True protein was higher in Chevignon compared to Activus, as higher values of Total AA and Total EAA were found in Chevignon), whereas crude fiber was higher in Activus. Under P fertilization, significant differences were found in CP, ADF, and CEL; CP under struvite was ∼13 % lower than under superphosphate and ∼4 % lower than in the control. Phosphorus fertilization also enhanced sulfur-containing amino acids, especially cystine and methionine content and their relative to lysine (as LYS = 100 %). Chevignon showed higher total and essential amino acid content. Overall, struvite maintained yield and improved grain quality—particularly Mg, Fe, and some amino acids—indicating potential as a sustainable fertilizer, despite results being limited to a single season on acidic soil.

■ 日本語タイトル: Enhancing flame retardancy of PLA with cellulose additives – effects of cellulose content and particle size
■ Original Title: Enhancing flame retardancy of PLA with cellulose additives – effects of cellulose content and particle size
■ 関連タグ: ホワイトニング, 環境・排水処理（ノイズ候補）
■ 著者: 
■ 発行年: 2026 (Source: PPR)
■ 原著論文リンク(PDF/記事): https://doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.rs-10381835/v1

■ Original English Abstract:
<title>Abstract</title>  <p>The influence of cellulose fibre content and fibre length on the thermal, mechanical, and flame-retardant properties of poly(lactic acid) (PLA) composites containing 15 wt% ammonium polyphosphate (APP) was investigated. Composites containing 5 and 10 wt% cellulose fibres of different lengths were characterised by thermogravimetric analysis (TGA), differential scanning calorimetry (DSC), limiting oxygen index (LOI), UL 94 burning test, cone calorimetry, flexural testing, and compression testing of the combustion residues. Cellulose incorporation slightly reduced the initial thermal stability of the composites but increased char residue, indicating enhanced char-forming capability. DSC analysis showed that cellulose fibres significantly influenced the crystallisation behaviour of PLA; short fibres at 5 wt% provided the most effective nucleating effect. All cellulose-containing formulations achieved a UL 94 V-0 classification, demonstrating the synergistic flame-retardant effect of APP and cellulose fibres. Among the investigated composites, the formulation containing 5 wt% long (60 µm) cellulose fibres reached the highest LOI, the lowest peak heat release rate and total smoke production, which was associated with the greatest expansion of the intumescent char. Compression testing confirmed that this formulation also produced the mechanically most stable combustion residue, establishing a clear correlation between char integrity and improved fire performance. This mechanically reinforced char effectively reduced both heat release and smoke generation, demonstrating that optimizing cellulose fibre geometry and concentration is essential for developing sustainable PLA composites with enhanced flame retardancy, smoke suppression, and mechanical performance.</p>

Soil salinity and sodicity are among the major challenges threatening agricultural productivity in the Central Rift Valley of Ethiopia. A column experiment was conducted in laboratory on saline-sodic soils of Metehara Sugar Estate to evaluate the effectiveness of phosphogypsum and leaching in reclaiming these soils. The treatments comprised of five rates of phosphogypsum equivalent to 50, 75, 100, 150, and 200% gypsum requirement, 100% gypsum requirement of natural gypsum, and an absolute control with no amendments applied, and five volumes of leaching water. Results of the study suggest that phosphogypsum is a promising reclamation material for saline-sodic soils. However, a field experiment has to be conducted to evaluate the effectiveness of these amendments under natural conditions and come-up with implementable rate recommendations.

■ Original English Abstract:
Inorganic polyphosphate (polyP), a linear polymer of orthophosphate residues, is involved in a range of cellular processes, including phosphate storage, blood clotting, chromatin remodeling, RNA processing, and mitochondrial function. Despite its significance, tools for monitoring polyP with specificity and in real time are lacking, limiting insights into its dynamics. Here, we present FRAPPe (FRET-based Ratiometric Analysis of Polyphosphate), a FRET-based sensor for polyP. FRAPPe consists of an eCFP–eYFP FRET pair flanking CHAD, a polyP-binding domain. The sensor remains unresponsive to nucleic acids and other polyanions, while polyP binding induces a significant decrease in FRET, allowing quantitative estimation of polyP. We further show that FRAPPe can qualitatively estimate polyP levels from crude cell extracts, supporting its utility in high-throughput genetic and pharmacological screens to identify regulators of polyP metabolism and signaling.

■ 日本語タイトル: From dynamic transcripts to stable proteins: multi-omics revealed regulatory buffering of Candidatus Accumulibacter under cyclic conditions
■ Original Title: From dynamic transcripts to stable proteins: multi-omics revealed regulatory buffering of Candidatus Accumulibacter under cyclic conditions
■ 著者: 
■ 発行年: 2026 (Source: PPR)
■ 原著論文リンク(PDF/記事): https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.10.758232

■ Original English Abstract:
Enhanced biological phosphorus removal (EBPR) relies on polyphosphate-accumulating organisms that experience dynamic fluctuations in redox conditions and substrate availability. How these organisms regulate metabolism across molecular layers under cyclic operation remains incompletely understood. Here, we investigated molecular regulation in a long-term, stable aerobic granular sludge system dominated by Candidatus Accumulibacter. We combined metagenomics, time-resolved metatranscriptomics, and matched metaproteomics across three consecutive operational cycles. Genome-resolved metagenomics revealed an Accumulibacter-dominated community encoding canonical EBPR functions. Time-resolved metatranscriptomics revealed extensive and reproducible transcriptional dynamics affecting hundreds of genes. This indicated that transcriptional dynamics did not translate into measurable changes in protein pool size on the time scale of individual cycles, consistent with slow, growth-coupled proteome turnover relative to cycle duration. Together, these results support a hierarchical model of regulation in Candidatus Accumulibacter, in which dynamic transcriptional responses are buffered at both the functional and protein levels. This organization provides a plausible basis for stable EBPR performance under predictable cyclic operation and demonstrates how time-resolved multi-omics can be used to resolve regulatory dynamics across molecular layers in engineered microbial ecosystems.

■ Original English Abstract:
Coenocytic algae are organisms that undergo karyokinesis without cytokinesis, resulting in multinucleated cells. Most research on bacterial communities in coenocytic algae has used 16S rRNA sequencing, primarily focusing on the order Bryopsidales of green coenocytic algae. Recent studies have analyzed metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs) from algal hosts across multiple taxa, such as Chlorophyta, Phaeophyta, and Rhodophyta, revealing more about bacterial biosynthetic machinery and potential symbiotic relationships. Given the cosmopolitan distribution of coenocytic algae, such as  Bryopsis ,  Caulerpa ,  Codium , and the yellow-green alga  Vaucheria , and their unique morphology, there is a need to better understand their associated bacterial communities. <title>Abstract</title>  <p>Elastomers such as acrylonitrile–butadiene rubber (NBR) are widely used in high-performance applications, yet their intrinsic flammability poses serious safety challenges. This study introduces hybrid nano-additive systems designed to enhance the fire resistance of NBR-based elastomers through the synergistic action of organic, inorganic, and biopolymeric components. The developed formulations incorporate melamine (M), melamine polyphosphate (PM), casein (K), and keratin recovered from industrial waste (P), combined via conventional and hybrid compounding methods. This work demonstrates a synergistic flame-retardant mechanism in NBR elastomers, integrating thermal shielding, char formation, and endothermic decomposition pathways. Moreover, the use of biodegradable waste-derived additives enhances the sustainability profile of the materials. The developed hybrid nano-additive systems offer a promising pathway toward eco-efficient, flame-retardant elastomers for applications in sectors with elevated fire hazard, such as automotive, aerospace, and electronics.</p>

Inositol hexakisphosphate kinase 1 (IP6K1) regulates platelet polyphosphate (polyP) homeostasis, yet their roles in NEC remain unclear. This study aimed to investigate the regulatory mechanism of platelet IP6K1 in neutrophil-platelet aggregate (NPA) formation and NEC pathogenesis, as well as the therapeutic potential of IP6K1 inhibition. <title>Abstract</title>  <p>Winter construction requires environmentally friendly binders capable of hardening at low temperatures. The use of ground granulated blast furnace slag and phosphogypsum (PG) contributes to sustainability primarily through waste valorization and reduced clinker dependence, both of which lower environmental impact relative to Portland cement–based binders. Slag and PG are industrial by-products that require no high temperature processing for use in alkali-activated systems, which significantly decreases energy demand compared with clinker production. <h4>Background</h4>  Activated platelets release polyphosphate (polyP), a linear polymer of inorganic phosphate residues, from dense granules. Experiments performed under no-flow conditions show that polyP alters the kinetics of tissue factor (TF) pathway reactions, accelerating FXI activation by thrombin and FV activation by FXa and thrombin, and may impact inhibition by tissue factor pathway inhibitor α (TFPIα). How polyP influences this pathway in conjunction with platelet deposition under flow remains understudied. <h4>Objectives</h4>  To investigate how polyP-mediated acceleration of FV and FXI activation modulates thrombin generation under flow in TF-initiated coagulation. <h4>Methods</h4>  We extended a previously validated mathematical model of platelet deposition and coagulation under flow to examine polyP-mediated effects following a small vascular injury during intravascular clotting. For TF densities above this threshold, polyP shortens the lag time to thrombin generation in a TF- and shear-rate-dependent manner. Although no explicit effect of polyP on TFPIα function was included in the model, thrombin generation was much less sensitive to TFPIα concentration with polyP, in a TF-dependent manner. Relative contributions of accelerations of FV and FXI activations depend on incompletely known enhancements by polyP. <h4>Conclusions</h4>  The experimentally observed influence of polyP on TFPIα function depends on TF density and may arise indirectly from accelerated FV and FXI activation, with the dominant effect arising through accelerated thrombin-mediated conversion of FV to FVa.

Ap  4 A is a stress- and immune-associated nucleotide metabolite proposed to act as a second messenger, raising the possibility that NUDT2 targeting may unintentionally affect important nucleotide-sensitive signaling pathways. Phosphorus (P) scarcity is forcing a shift from mineral-based fertilization to a circular economy-based strategy. However, replacing P mineral fertilizer with organic fertilizers requires further research under field conditions, given the complexity of the P forms present in these fertilizers. To assess the efficiency of organic P fertilizers, a field study was conducted in southern Spain, comparing olive husk compost and two vermicomposts with superphosphate. The experiment was replicated twice between 2018 and 2022, involving each one a 3-year crop rotation (durum wheat-sunflower-pea), where fertilization was only applied before the first crop. The apparent P recovery (APR) in the first crop was not significantly different between the fertilizers. The results reveal that organic fertilizers can effectively replace mineral fertilizers in rainfed Mediterranean crop rotations, with a significant residual effect when fertilization is not applied annually.

Understanding how bacterial metabolism shapes virulence requires infection models that are both biologically informative and experimentally accessible. Using this approach, we show that disruption of polyphosphate (polyP) synthesis by loss of  ppk1 gene (τ1  ppk1 ) leads to marked attenuation of virulence, whereas interrupting  ppk2 gene (τ1  ppk2 ) results in a hypervirulent phenotype. ■ Original English Abstract:
<h4>ABSTRACT</h4>  Polyphosphate (polyP), a linear polymer of orthophosphate residues, is enriched in secretory granules in specialised mammalian cell types including platelets and mast cells. Although polyP released during activation and degranulation of these cells has been shown to promote blood clotting and inflammation, little is known about the mechanisms governing polyP synthesis in these granules. Increased concern for both Great Lakes water quality and potato (Solanum tuberosum L.) phosphorus (P) requirements emphasize reviewing guidelines with regard to P fertilizer rates and potato response. ■ 日本語タイトル: Regulation of polyphosphate homeostasis in  <i>S. cerevisiae</i>  by the Sky1 protein kinase
■ Original Title: Regulation of polyphosphate homeostasis in  <i>S. cerevisiae</i>  by the Sky1 protein kinase
■ 関連タグ: ミトコンドリア・代謝
■ 著者: 
■ 発行年: 2026 (Source: PPR)
■ 原著論文リンク(PDF/記事): https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.24.753767

■ 日本語要約:
ABSTRACT  Eukaryotic cells store inorganic phosphate in the form of long chains called polyphosphates (polyP) that can reach many hundreds of residues in length. In the budding yeast  Saccharomyces cerevisiae , polyP is synthesized by the VTC complex using ATP as a substrate and sequestered at high concentrations in the vacuole. Here, polyP chain length and turnover are regulated by the polyphosphatase enzymes Ppn1 and Ppn2. In the vacuole lumen, polyP plays a critical role in phosphate and ion homeostasis. Beyond the vacuole, minor populations of polyP are thought to impact various cellular functions, including in the nucleus, in part by binding to target proteins. We speculated that polyP metabolism must be tightly coupled to mechanisms of homeostatic control operating elsewhere in the cell. In this work, we report that cells lacking Sky1, a serine-arginine repeat protein kinase, have very low levels of polyP, an effect that is exacerbated by alkaline stress. Under these conditions  sky1 Δ mutants also display increased expression of a subset of genes from the PHO regulon. Genetic analysis suggests that both phenotypes are linked to an increase in potassium influx via the Trk1 potassium transporter. Loss of Npl3, a known target of Sky1, partially rescues the phosphate homeostasis defects in  sky1 Δ mutants, although this occurs independently of a well characterized Sky1 phosphorylation site on Npl3. Finally, the loss of polyP in  sky1 Δ mutants depends on the Ppn1 and Ppn2 polyphosphatases and the Pep4 protease located in the vacuole. Altogether, our work provides novel insights into how polyP homeostasis in the vacuole is coordinated with events occurring throughout the cell.

■ Original Title: Regulatory effects of phosphogypsum application on soil quality and plant physiology: A global meta-analysis
■ 関連タグ: ホワイトニング
■ 著者: 
■ 発行年: 2026 (Source: PPR)
■ 原著論文リンク(PDF/記事): https://doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.rs-10800698/v1

■ 日本語要約:

■ Original English Abstract:
<title>Abstract</title>  <p>Phosphogypsum (PG), a bulk solid by-product produced from wet phosphoric acid manufacturing, can be used as a soil amendment after harmless and functional modification in agricultural production. This greatly reduces the environmental and land pressure stemming from PG stockpiles but also conforms to the development of resource recycling and green agriculture. However, how PG application methods (alone or combined) and dosage gradients affect soil physicochemical properties, plant physiology, and microbial community structure has not been systematically or quantitatively assessed, limiting its precise and standardized use across diverse ecological regions and farming systems. Based on a strict screening of 44 global empirical studies, we conducted a multi-dimensional meta-analysis to systematically quantify the effects of PG application on soil quality, crop growth, enzyme activity, and soil microbial diversity. The results showed that the application of PG alone significantly improved soil fertility by increasing soil organic matter (+27.5%), field water holding capacity (+38.0%), available phosphorus (+58.6%), alkali-hydrolysable nitrogen (+25.0%) and ammonium nitrogen (+26.0%), total potassium (+15.8%) and total nitrogen (+21.3%), while reducing soil pH by 12%. At the plant level, PG significantly promoted biomass accumulation (+22.9%), plant height growth (+18.9%), root length (+16.5%), and calcium enrichment in the aboveground (+126.1%). In terms of combined application, the use of PG in conjunction with biochar reversed the acidification, increasing soil pH by 14.9%. The combined application of PG and compound fertilizer showed significant synergistic effects: soil total potassium content increased by 86.5%, K⁺ and Ca²⁺ concentrations in plants increased by 112.3% and 147.9% respectively, Na⁺ content significantly decreased by 85.7%, and simultaneously achieved a significant increase in crop yield (+43.2%) and plant height (+35.3%). At the biological response level, PG significantly enhanced soil β-glucosidase (+6.6%) and urease (+20.4%) activities and increased chlorophyll content in plants (+20.3%). Meanwhile, it significantly activated the plant antioxidant system, with superoxide dismutase (SOD) and catalase (CAT) activities increasing by 15.6% and 42.6% respectively. However, a decrease of 18.2% in fungal community α-diversity (Chao1 index) was observed, suggesting the need to pay attention to the potential regulatory effects of long-term application on the structure of the soil microbial community. The sensitivity analysis of application dosage showed that the medium and low dosage range of 10%–50% (mass ratio) of PG application presented the best comprehensive benefits in most studies, which is conducive to expanding the soil nutrient pool and promoting the stable growth of crops. In conclusion, this study provides systematic scientific basis and practical parameter support for the agricultural resource utilization of phosphogypsum under the premise of ecological safety, and has important theoretical value and application significance for building a modern farmland ecosystem that is nutrient-efficient, environmentally friendly, and resiliently sustainable.</p>

To survive stressful conditions, bacteria enter the stringent response mediated by the magic spot nucleotides (MSN) guanosine 3’5’-bispyrophosphate (ppGpp) and guanosine 3’-diphosphate 5’-triphosphate (pppGpp). Another group of so-called alarmones elevated under stress are dinucleoside polyphosphates (Np  n Ns), such as diadenosine triphosphate (Ap  3 A). How these two groups of alarmones intersect with one another is poorly understood. Here, we present a sensitive method using capillary electrophoresis coupled to mass spectrometry (CE-MS) with heavy isotope labeled internal references to separate and quantify magic spot nucleotides in parallel with Np  n Ns. This approach uncovered oscillatory fluctuations in MSN and some Np  n N during exponential growth, suggesting more dynamic regulation of the stringent response than previously thought. In addition, up to eleven Np  n Ns were detected after prolonged growth. Np  n N levels were also quantified under various amino acid starvation conditions, revealing a pronounced accumulation in late stationary phase. In summary, our parallel assignment and quantification of highly charged signaling molecules in bacteria under stress conditions paves the way to better study and understand the cross-talk between different alarmones.

■ Original English Abstract:
The Chinese Baijiu industry produces over one billion tons of distiller’s dried grains with solubles (DDGS) annually, posing a significant environmental challenge. Traditional methods of utilization are hindered by numerous limitations, including insufficient treatment, low-value processing, and high energy consumption. In this study, ammonium polyphosphate (APP), an inorganic adhesive, was employed to bond DDGS for its materialization. This study not only addresses the challenge of effectively repurposing DDGS but also provides a pioneering and practical approach for the industrial application of DDGS-based particleboards.

■ 著者:

■ 日本語要約:
Background:  Chitosan-nanoparticles (CS-NPs) offer an effective approach to drug delivery for treating HIV/AIDS. However, how the interaction of CS-NPs with the blood-brain barrier (BBB) in the context of HIV infection remains unclear. In this study, we investigated the effects of CS-NPs and HIV proteins in endothelial cells of a BBB model. Methods: CS-NPs were synthesized through ionic gelation at various Chitosan: tripolyphosphate (CS:TPP) mass ratios. bEnd5 cells were treated with CS-NPs alone, HL2/3-derived HIV-conditioned media (HIV-CM; 20%, 40%, or 75%), or their combination for 24–96 h. The findings highlight the significance of CS:TPP ratio, dose, exposure duration, and HIV protein exposure when evaluating CS-NPs in HIV-related neuropathology. The study provides preclinical evidence of the effects of CS-NPs on BBB integrity and brain endothelial cell health, providing insights into their future development as antiretroviral nano-carriers.

■ Original English Abstract:
<h4>ABSTRACT</h4>  Inorganic polyphosphate (polyP) is an ancient polymer conserved across all life, serving cell type- and location–specific functions in every major compartment. Yet its role at the plasma membrane, where it accumulates to peak levels in many primary cells, is largely unknown. Here we identify polyP as a stabilizing component of filopodia, actin-based membrane protrusions that govern cell adhesion, contact inhibition, and chemotaxis. Elevating cellular polyP increases filopodial stability and enhances cell adhesion, whereas reducing polyP accelerates filopodial disassembly and promotes cell migration. ■ Original Title: The roles and synthesis of inorganic polyphosphate in  <i>Bacillus cereus</i>
■ 著者: 
■ 発行年: 2026 (Source: PPR)

■ Original English Abstract:
Inorganic polyphosphate (polyP) is a universally conserved biopolymer central to bacterial stress survival, yet understanding of its roles derives almost entirely from Gram-negative models in which polyP accumulates intracellularly following nutrient downshift. We examined polyP metabolism in the Gram-positive spore-forming bacterium  Bacillus cereus using deletions of the polyP kinases PPK1 and PPK2 and the exopolyphosphatase PPX. Intracellular polyP synthesis required PPK1 and was opposed by PPX and PPK2:  ppx mutants accumulated polyP in sporulation medium by 24 hours,  ppx ppk2 double mutants accumulated more, and no  ppk1 mutant accumulated any. A  ppk1 ppx double mutant could not be generated, suggesting that unopposed PPK2 activity is lethal. Unlike  Escherichia coli and  Pseudomonas aeruginosa ,  B. cereus did not accumulate polyP after shift to minimal medium, increasing only modestly in stationary phase. Fluorescence and transmission electron microscopy localized intracellular polyP to electron-dense granules within ribosome-depleted cytoplasm. Cells bearing these granules remained membrane-intact yet failed to resume growth over 8 hours in rich medium, leading us to propose that polyP drives ribosome sequestration into condensates and a hibernation-like state. Unexpectedly,  B. cereus also released close to 100µM polyP extracellularly during late stationary phase, even in a  ppk1 ppk2 mutant lacking both known synthetases. Extracellular polyP resisted hydrolysis by purified PPX even after deproteinization, indicating an atypical structure.  Bacillus thuringiensis and  Bacillus anthracis released similar amounts of extracellular polyP. Together these results identify two distinct polyP pools in the  B. cereus group: a PPK1-dependent intracellular pool and an extracellular pool made by an uncharacterized pathway.  <h4>Importance</h4>  Bacillus cereus is a spore-forming bacterium that causes foodborne illness and persists in soil and food-processing environments, where survival depends on managing phosphate and energy reserves during starvation. Inorganic polyphosphate (polyP), an ancient polymer used by nearly all cells to withstand stress, has been studied almost entirely as a molecule stored inside bacteria. We show that  Bacillus cereus maintains two separate polyP pools. The internal pool is made by a known enzyme (PPK1) and is associated with dormant cells whose protein-making machinery appears to be packed away. The external pool is made without any known polyP-synthesizing enzyme, pointing to a novel polyP synthesis pathway that is shared with the close relatives  Bacillus thuringiensis and  Bacillus anthracis .

Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) sometimes induce immune-related adverse events (irAEs), and arthritis is one of the irAE symptoms. Recently, crystal-induced arthritis, such as calcium pyrophosphate (CPP) crystal deposition disease and gout, has been reported to occur after ICI administration. Inorganic polyphosphate (polyP) is a ubiquitous biopolymer composed of multiple orthophosphates connected by energy-rich phosphoanhydride bonds. In organisms, polyP is digested by two types of enzymes: exopolyphosphatases, which shorten the chain from the ends by cleaving off monophosphate units, and endopolyphosphatases, which cut the chain internally. This approach thus represents a significant addition to existing methodologies, facilitating the discovery and classification of new endopoly-phosphatases and their inhibitors to advance our understanding of polyP metabolism and regulation.

The opportunistic human pathogen Pseudomonas aeruginosa (Pa), a leading cause of severe infections, becomes increasingly resistant to antibiotics, including the last resort antibiotic, polymyxin-B (PMB). リン石膏はリン酸塩産業の副産物であり、主に ²²⁶Ra、²¹⁰Po、²¹⁰Pb などの重金属や天然放射性核種の濃度が高くなる。持続可能性の目標とグリーンケミストリーを考慮すると、土壌改良材や土壌改良剤としての使用もその 1 つとして、多くの商業用途を持つ資源とも考えられている。このアプリケーションは、これらの汚染物質を人間の食物連鎖に導入する可能性があるため、潜在的な危険を引き起こす可能性もある。植物の吸収は、これらの放射性核種と土壌粒子の結合に依存します。この研究では、リン石膏で改良された典型的な地中海土壌を考慮し、2 つの異なる連続抽出スキームを元の土壌、リン石膏と改良土壌に適用した。リン石膏の適用により、放射性核種が土壌粒子に結合するパターンが変化した。これらの抽出の結果から、改良された土壌では、希酸および中程度の還元性画分へのウランの会合が増加したことが観察された。一方、²¹⁶Po についても、²²⁶Ra 交換可能画分の減少と還元可能画分の増加が観察されました。リン石膏中の最も重要な放射性核種である ²²⁶Ra および ²¹⁰Po の分布は、元の土壌とリン石膏からの個々の分布から導き出すことはできません。最後に、ヒト以外の生物相への線量率は国際基準を下回っており、したがって悪影響は予想されませんであった。

■ Original English Abstract:
Phosphogypsum is a by-product of the phosphate industry, which presents enhanced concentrations of heavy metals and naturally occurring radionuclides, mainly ²²⁶Ra, ²¹⁰Po and ²¹⁰Pb. Taking into account sustainability goal and green chemistry, it is also considered a resource with numerous commercial applications, being its use as soil conditioner and/or amendment one of them. This application can also cause a potential hazard because it may introduce these contaminants into the human foodchain. Plant uptake depends on the association of these radionuclides to soil particles. In this study, we considered a typical Mediterranean soil which was amended with phosphogypsum, and two different sequential extraction schemes were applied to the original soil, phosphogypsum and amended soil. Phosphogypsum application did modify the pattern in which radionuclides were associated to soil particles. From the results of these extractions, it was observed that in amended soil uranium association to diluted-acid and moderately reducible fraction increased; while a reduction of ²²⁶Ra exchangeable fraction and an increase of reducible fractions, also for ²¹⁰Po, was observed. Distribution of ²²⁶Ra and ²¹⁰Po, most important radionuclides in phosphogypsum, cannot be derived from the individual distribution from original soil and phosphogypsum. Finally, the dose rates to non-human biota were below international benchmarks, and therefore no deleterious effects were to be expected.

リン石膏 (PG) 熱分解産業ユニットの起動と運転の成功には、パイロット プラントのテストとデモンストレーションが不可欠です。比例スケールアップ原理に従って、PG 熱分解の自熱操作特性とプロセス統合の可能性を習得するために、1 時間あたり 1,300 kg の PG を処理するための完全なフロー パイロット システム モデルが確立されました。この結果は、石炭酸素の相乗制御と固相床材料の事前脱水が、PG 分解脱硫システムの自己熱効率の高い安定した運転を確保するための鍵であることを示している。反応雰囲気として H₂O + 空気を選択し、システムの動作温度を下げると、プロセスの自己熱に必要なエネルギーを削減できますが、性能の向上は、反応蒸気の内部自給自足と PG の低温分解時間の最適化された短縮に依存します。最適な熱統合ネットワークのグローバル設計は、気固体製品からの廃熱を回収して冷却水と冷気の両方を加熱して、それぞれ反応蒸気を供給し、石炭を乾燥させることによって達成され、熱交換後の排ガスはPGの焙煎に使用されました。プロセス全体で必要なのは、冷却ユーティリティの供給のみであった。酸素供給量が 410 kg/h、石炭供給量が 411 kg/h のオートサーマル条件下では、SO2 モル濃度は 31.84% であった。 PG の熱分解による CaO の製造は、従来のセメント製造プロセスよりも経済的かつ環境的に実行可能であった。年間純利益は従来のプロセスの 2.5 倍であり、CO₂ 排出量は 1.70% 削減されました。

■ Original English Abstract:
The successful start-up and operation of phosphogypsum (PG) thermal decomposition industrial units are inseparable from the testing and demonstration of the pilot plant. Following the proportional scale-up principle, a complete flow pilot system model for treating 1300 kg of PG per hour was established, to master the autothermal operation characteristics and process integration potential of PG thermal decomposition. The results indicate that the synergistic regulation of coal-oxygen and pre-dehydration of the solid-phase bed material are key to ensuring the autothermal efficient stable operation of PG decomposition desulfurization systems. Selecting H₂O + Air as the reaction atmosphere and lowering the system operating temperature can reduce the energy demand for process autothermal, but performance improvements depend on the internal self-sufficiency of the reaction vapor and optimized reduction of the PG low-temperature decomposition time. The global design of an optimal heat integration network is achieved by recovering the waste heat from gas-solid products to heat the both cooling water and cold air to supply the reaction vapor and dry the coal respectively, and the flue gas after heat exchange was used to roast the PG. The entire process required only a supply of cooling utilities. Under autothermal conditions with an oxygen supply and coal feed of 410 and 411 kg/h, respectively, the SO₂ molar concentration was 31.84 %. Producing CaO through PG thermal decomposition was more economically and environmentally feasible than the traditional cement production process. The annual net income was 2.5-fold higher than that of the traditional process, with the CO₂ emissions being reduced by 1.70 %.

Magnetotactic bacteria (MTB) are capable of accumulating and storing intercellular pools containing phosphorus, sulfur, nitrogen and carbon. ■ Original Title: Chitosan-tripolyphosphate nanoparticles as a novel vehicle for DNA vaccine delivery: combatting Aeromonas hydrophila in zebrafish
■ 関連タグ: 創傷治癒
■ 著者: 
■ 発行年: 2025 (Source: AGR)
■ 原著論文リンク(PDF/記事): https://doi.org/10.1007/s10499-025-01927-8

■ 日本語要約:
(日本語要約なし)

■ Original English Abstract:
Over the past few decades, aquaculture has been steering the giant wheel of the world’s food production system. A number of significant diseases, such as dropsy, swelling of tissues, and haemorrhagic septicemia, are triggered by various bacterial species. In this study, we aimed to develop and achieve oral delivery of pVAX-Aly (Aerolysin) DNA vaccines in biodegradable nanoparticles using a zebrafish (Danio rerio) model to enhance defence against Aeromonas hydrophila infection. We utilized the pathogenic gene Aerolysin (Aly), which is linked to the virulence of A. hydrophila, to construct a DNA vaccine using the pVAX1 vector, designated as the pVAX-Aly DNA vaccine. Additionally, chitosan-tripolyphosphate nanoparticles (Cs/TPP-NPs) were formulated, functional groups were characterized by Fourier Transform Infrared (FT-IR) spectroscopy, morphology was determined by Field Emission Scanning Electron Microscopy (FE-SEM) (50.6 nm ± 52.8 nm), and transmission electron microscopy (TEM) imaging showed dimensions of ~ 0.5 to 1 µm. The Cs/TPP-NPs were utilized to encapsulate the pVAX-Aly DNA vaccine. The effectiveness of encapsulation of Cs/TPP-NPs was determined to be 78.5%. The lyophilized pVAX-Aly DNA-Cs/TPP complex preparations were fed to the fish, and the tissue distribution of pVAX-Aly was studied by polymerase chain reaction (PCR). Histopathological examination suggested no cell lesions and no negative impact on the vaccinated fish. Furthermore, quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR) was assessed, and the immune-related genes transferrin, lysozyme, tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α), and heat shock protein 70 (HSP70) also exhibited significantly higher expression after immunization. Additionally, the exposure of different concentrations of Cs/TPP-NPs to Danio rerio fibroblast (DrF) cell lines revealed no significant morphological abnormalities. The findings from this study demonstrated that the Cs/TPP-NPs encapsulated DNA vaccine administered through feed could improve disease resistance to A. hydrophila infection via upregulation of the immune-related gene (transferrin, lysozyme, TNF-α, and HSP70), good tissue distribution, maintenance of histological integrity, and enhancement of leukocyte population in Danio rerio.

■ 日本語タイトル: リンの割合と種類を組み合わせると、沿岸の塩分土壌と作物システムにおける塩イオンの恒常性が調節され、トウモロコシの収量が向上する
■ Original Title: Coupling phosphorus rate and type enhances maize yield by regulating salt ion homeostasis in coastal saline soil-crop systems
■ 関連タグ: ホワイトニング
■ 著者: 
■ 発行年: 2025 (Source: AGR)
■ 原著論文リンク(PDF/記事): https://europepmc.org/article/AGR/IND609267659

■ 日本語要約:
リン（P）の管理はトウモロコシの成長に影響を与え、沿岸塩分土壌における塩ストレスを軽減しますが、収量を高めるために土壌と作物系のイオン平衡を調節するためにリンの割合と種類を適合させる方法とその推進メカニズムはまだ不明です。我々は、単一過リン酸塩（SSP）、リン酸一アンモニウム（MAP）、ポリリン酸アンモニウム（APP）を含むリン酸の比率と種類の結合が、トウモロコシの収量、リンの取り込みとリンの農業効率（PAE）、土壌と作物系のカチオン恒常性、および沿岸塩性土壌における経済的利益に及ぼす影響を評価するために、6年間の野外試験（2017年から2022年）を実施した。 6 年間の圃場試験のデータを統合すると、3 つの P タイプの下で穀粒収量はリン施用量の増加と線形プラトー関係を示し、全体のプラトー収量が 18.88 ～ 22.32kgP ha⁻¹ で 8.51 ～ 9.21 Mg ha⁻¹ であることが示されました。変曲点レベルでは、水溶性ナトリウムの割合（WSSP）は59.9、ナトリウム吸着率（SAR）は2.2、土壌構造安定性の陽イオン比（CROSS）は2.5で、いずれもP処理なしの場合よりも大幅に低かった。トウモロコシの新芽イオン比の対応する変曲点は、Ca:Na で 24.8、K:Na で 172.4、Mg:Na で 18.2 であった。最適化された P レートのもとでの SSP は、APP および MAP で観察された減少よりも、WSSP を 12.1 ～ 12.9%、SAR を 19.2 ～ 23.3%、CROSS を 18.3 ～ 22.0% 減少させました。また、最適化された P 比率の下での SSP では、トウモロコシの芽の Ca:Na 比 (8.6 ～ 15.3%)、K:Na 比 (8.1 ～ 19.9%)、および Mg:Na 比 (11.1 ～ 25.3%) が、APP および MAP で観察された比よりも高くなりました。その結果、最適化された P レートの下での SSP は、トウモロコシの収量 (+8.06%)、PAE (+32.4%)、および純利益 (+18.2%) の向上をもたらした。この研究は、リン濃度と種類を考慮した土壌と作物システムのイオン恒常性に関する洞察を提供し、塩イオンバランスが作物の収量に影響を与えるメカニズムの理解を深め、沿岸塩分土壌で持続可能な農業を達成する上でリン管理の重要な役割を強調します。

■ Original English Abstract:
Phosphorus (P) management influences maize growth and mitigates salt stress in coastal saline soils, but how to match P rate and type to regulate soil–crop system ion equilibrium for higher yield and its driving mechanism remains unclear. We conducted a six-year field trial (2017–2022) to assess the effects of coupling P rates and types, including single superphosphate (SSP), monoammonium phosphate (MAP) and ammonium polyphosphate (APP), on maize yield, P uptake and P agronomic efficiency (PAE), soil–crop system cation homeostasis, and economic benefits in coastal saline soils. Pooling data from the six-year field trial, grain yield had a linear–plateau relationship with increasing P application rates under the three P types, showing an overall plateau yield of 8.51–9.21 Mg ha⁻¹ at 18.88–22.32 kg P ha⁻¹. At the inflection points level, the water-soluble sodium percentage (WSSP) was 59.9, the sodium adsorption ratio (SAR) was 2.2, and the cation ratio of soil structural stability (CROSS) was 2.5, all significantly lower than those under no P treatments. The corresponding inflection points for maize shoot ion ratios were 24.8 for Ca:Na, 172.4 for K:Na, and 18.2 for Mg:Na. The SSP under optimized P rate reduced WSSP by 12.1–12.9 %, SAR by 19.2–23.3 %, and CROSS by18.3–22.0 % more than the reduction observed for APP and MAP. Also, the SSP under optimized P rate resulted in higher maize shoot Ca:Na ratio (8.6–15.3 %), K:Na ratio (8.1–19.9 %) and Mg:Na ratio (11.1–25.3 %) than the ratios observed for APP and MAP. As a result, the SSP under optimized P rate resulted in higher maize yield (+8.06 %), PAE (+32.4 %), and net income (+18.2 %). This study provides insights into soil–crop system ionic homeostasis considering P rate and type, enhancing our understanding of the mechanisms by which salt ion balance affects crop yield and highlighting the critical role of P management in achieving sustainable agriculture in coastal saline soils.

■ 日本語タイトル: Cover crops and P‐fertilizer management affect microbial activity in a US Midwest corn and soybean rotation
■ Original Title: Cover crops and P‐fertilizer management affect microbial activity in a US Midwest corn and soybean rotation
■ 著者: 
■ 発行年: 2025 (Source: AGR)
■ 原著論文リンク(PDF/記事): https://doi.org/10.1002/agj2.21721

■ 日本語要約:
(日本語要約なし)

■ Original English Abstract:
Microorganisms can have a substantial effect on labile phosphorus (P), which may be lost from the soil surface and impact water quality. Changes in nutrient availability and soil health from agricultural management can affect microbial biomass carbon (MB‐C), microbial biomass phosphorus (MB‐P), and the expression of P cycling enzymes. The objective of this research was to investigate biological mechanisms affecting P availability and potential loss to runoff in a no‐till, corn (Zea mays)–soybean (Glycine max) cropping system with two cover crops (cover crop [CC] and no cover crop [NC]) and three P management treatments (fall broadcast [FB], spring injected ammonium polyphosphate [SI], and no phosphorus application [NP]). Treatments were applied to a randomized block design with three replicates. Soil samples were analyzed for MB‐P, MB‐C, phosphatase activity, and Mehlich‐III P (PM). The P supply to the soil solution was measured using diffusive gradient thin film P (PDGT). In Spring 2018, Fall 2018, and Spring 2019, all phosphatase activity was greater in CC versus NC (p < 0.01). Microbial biomass C was greater in CC compared with NC in spring but not fall samplings. On average, MB‐P was fivefold greater in the P fertilized than unfertilized treatments (p < 0.001). CCs did not change MB‐P, PM, or PDGT within FB or NP, but did affect SI fertilizer treatments. Our results suggest CC can increase potential for organic P mineralization, application of P fertilizer increases MB‐P, and an interaction between SI P fertilizer management and CC may increase P supply to the soil solution.

■ 日本語タイトル: Litopenaeus vannamei におけるコラーゲン糖ペプチドの凍結保護効果と構造的特徴
■ Original Title: Cryoprotective effects and structural characteristics of collagen glycopeptides on Litopenaeus vannamei
■ 関連タグ: ミトコンドリア・代謝
■ 著者: 
■ 発行年: 2025 (Source: AGR)
■ 原著論文リンク(PDF/記事): https://europepmc.org/article/AGR/IND609285648

■ 日本語要約:
この研究では、ティラピア皮膚コラーゲンペプチドのグリコシル化によって調製された高純度グリコペプチド（GPP）の、5回の凍結融解サイクル中のリトペナエウス・バナメイに対する凍結保護効果を調査した。その結果、GPP が凍結融解サイクル中の Litopenaeus vannamei の微細構造を改善しながら、解凍時の水分損失を効果的に低減し、塩可溶性タンパク質含量と総スルフヒドリル基の減少を最小限に抑え、Ca2+-ATPase 活性を維持し、表面疎水性の増加を抑制することが示されました。 2% 濃度では、GPP は 0.5% 市販のポリリン酸塩不凍液と同等の凍結保護効果を示しましたが、3% GPP はポリリン酸塩処理の性能を上回りました。さらに、分子ドッキングの結果から、GPPは主に水素結合形成を通じて氷結晶との相互作用を強化し、それによって氷結晶の成長を阻害することが明らかになった。これらの発見は、新規かつ効率的な凍結保護剤としての GPP の重要な可能性を強調し、冷凍食品におけるグリコシル化不凍液ペプチドの応用に対する理論的裏付けと実用的な参考資料を提供します。

■ Original English Abstract:
This study investigated the cryoprotective effects of high-purity glycopeptide (GPP), prepared by glycosylation of tilapia skin collagen peptides, on Litopenaeus vannamei during five freeze-thaw cycles. The results showed that GPP effectively reduced thawing water loss, minimized the decrease in salt-soluble protein content and total sulfhydryl groups, maintained Ca²⁺-ATPase activity, and suppressed the increase in surface hydrophobicity, while improving the microstructure of Litopenaeus vannamei during freeze-thaw cycles. At a 2 % concentration, GPP exhibited comparable cryoprotective efficacy to 0.5 % commercial polyphosphate antifreeze, while 3 % GPP surpassed the performance of the polyphosphate treatment. Furthermore, molecular docking results revealed that GPP mainly enhanced its interaction with ice crystals through hydrogen bond formation, thereby inhibiting ice crystal growth. These findings highlight the significant potential of GPP as a novel and efficient cryoprotectant, providing theoretical support and practical references for the application of glycosylated antifreeze peptides in frozen food products.

■ 日本語タイトル: 霜が降りやすい地域における樹種の生存と成長のための管理オプションの開発
■ Original Title: Developing management option for the survival and growth of tree species in frost prone areas.
■ 著者: 
■ 発行年: 2025 (Source: PPR)
■ 原著論文リンク(PDF/記事): https://doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.rs-1929282/v1

■ 日本語要約:
要約 エチオピアは、荒廃した土地を修復または回復するために多大な努力を払ってきましたが、これらの努力は、土壌肥沃度の低下と極端な季節的霜によって妨げられてきました。凍害は苗木の確立と発育の初期段階に最も深刻であるため、霜が降りやすい地域での苗木の迅速な確立と成長を可能にする適切な造林管理手法に関する研究を優先することが重要です。この研究は、霜が降りやすい地域での実生の生存を改善するための効果的な造林方法を特定することを目的としていました。実験は、3 回の反復によるランダム化完全ブロック設計 (RCBD) を用いた実施されました。処理には、水やりを伴う栄養マルチ、水やりのみ、定植時の三重過リン酸塩の適用 (200 kg ha^-1)、150 kg ha^-1 尿素、および 100 kg ha^-1 尿素 (定植後 6、12、18、および 24 か月後に適用)、INA 細菌濃度を制御するための銅化合物の噴霧、冷気排水を制御するための物理的バリア、およびその結果、霜が降りやすい地域では、水やりを伴うマルチングと水やりのみが最良の造林苗管理方法であることが明らかにした。これら 2 つの造林管理実践により、苗齢 3 年の時点で対照と比較して、高さ、根輪の直径、および苗の生存率が 34% 増加した。マルチングと潅水により、凍害の影響を軽減し、苗の生存率は83％に達した。水やりと散水によるマルチングは、霜の影響を軽減するのにプラスの効果しかありません。パチュラマツの成長パフォーマンスを最適化するために、さらなる調査を推奨します。さらに、制御された環境下で三重過リン酸塩 + 尿素および銅化合物処理の効果を評価することにより、貴重な洞察が得られます。

■ Original English Abstract:
<title>Abstract</title>  <p>Ethiopia has made significant efforts to rehabilitate or restore degraded lands, but these efforts have been hampered by low soil fertility and extreme seasonal frost. Since frost damage is most severe during the early stages of seedling establishment and development, it is crucial to prioritize research on suitable silvicultural management practices that enable rapid establishment and growth of young trees in frost-prone regions. The study aimed to identify effective silvicultural practices for improving seedling survival in frost-prone regions.The experiment was conducted using a Randomized Complete Block Design (RCBD) with three replications. The treatments included vegetative mulches with watering, watering alone, application of triple superphosphate at planting (200 kg ha^-1), 150 kg ha^-1 urea, and 100 kg ha^-1 urea (applied at 6, 12, 18, and 24 months after planting), spraying copper compounds to control INA bacteria concentrations, physical barriers to control cold air drainage, and a control.The results reveal that mulching with watering and watering alone are the best silvicultural seedling management practices in frost-prone areas. These two silvicultural management practices resulted in a 34% increase in height, root collar diameter and seedling survival rate compared to the control at 3 years age of seedling. Seedling survival reached 83% that was managed by mulching with watering by reduce the impact of frost damage. Mulching with watering and watering only have a positive effect on mitigating the impact of frost.We recommend further investigations to optimize the growth performance of Pinus patula. Additionally, evaluating the effects of triple superphosphate + urea and copper compound treatments under controlled environments would provide valuable insights.</p>

要約 メタン生成は伝統的に、CO2、酢酸塩、メチル化化合物 (メタノール、メチルアミンなど)、メトキシル化芳香族化合物、アルカンなどの限られた範囲の低分子量 (LMW) 基質 (MW  1,000 Da）をメタン生成菌によるメタン生成に直接利用することは報告されていない。今回我々は、新規の深海メタン生成古細菌であるZRKC1株が、多糖類、特にメチルエステル化された形態（ペクチンなど）をメタン生産に直接利用できることを示す。この発見は、メタン生成の既知の基質の範囲を拡大し、これまでに特徴付けられていたメカニズムとは異なる新しい代謝経路を明らかにします。さらに、ZRKC1株は、多糖類の利用と無機ポリリン酸（ポリP）代謝を独特に結び付け、多糖類の加水分解中に放出される有機リン酸塩からポリPを蓄積します。重要なことに、我々は、ポリPの形成がZRKC1株の増殖とメタン生成の両方に必須であることを実証し、これまで認識されていなかった代謝依存性を明らかにし、ポリPがメタン生成菌の炭素フラックスを調節していることを示唆した。これは、メタン生成菌の多糖類およびポリP依存性増殖に関する初の報告であり、エネルギー節約と栄養制限環境への適応のための新しい代謝戦略を提示し、地球規模の炭素とリンの循環におけるメタン生成菌の生態学的重要性を強調している。

■ Original English Abstract:
<title>Abstract</title>  <p>Methanogenesis has traditionally been associated with a limited range of low-molecular-weight (LMW) substrates (MW < 1,000 Da), including CO<sub>2</sub>, acetate, methylated compounds (e.g., methanol, methylamines), methoxylated aromatic compounds, and alkanes. However, the direct utilization of high-molecular-weight (HMW) organic matter (MW > 1,000 Da), such as polysaccharides, for methane production by methanogens has not been reported. Here, we show that a novel deep-sea methanogenic archaeon, strain ZRKC1, can directly utilize polysaccharides, particularly methyl-esterified forms (e.g., pectin), for methane production. This discovery expands the known substrate range for methanogenesis and unveils a new metabolic pathway distinct from previously characterized mechanisms. Furthermore, strain ZRKC1 uniquely couples polysaccharide utilization with inorganic polyphosphate (polyP) metabolism, accumulating polyP from organic phosphates released during polysaccharide hydrolysis. Importantly, we demonstrate that polyP formation is essential for both growth and methanogenesis in strain ZRKC1, revealing a previously unrecognized metabolic dependency and suggesting that polyP regulates carbon flux in methanogens. This is the first report of polysaccharide- and polyP-dependent growth in methanogens, presenting a novel metabolic strategy for energy conservation and adaptation to nutrient-limited environments and underscoring the ecological significance of methanogens in global carbon and phosphorus cycles.</p>

■ Original English Abstract:
Thermoplastic compounds are used in several industrial, domestic and consumer applications. Thanks to their strength, lightness, flexibility and processing properties, they are also widely used for engineering purposes (EngTh). However, thermoplastics are often derived from polymers formed from non-renewable sources, such as oil. In addition, the production processes have a high consumption of energy. This research aims to evaluate the environmental impacts with the Life Cycle Assessment methodology of three polymers based on polyamide 6.6 modified with flame retardants (brominated polystyrene and antimony trioxide, aluminium diethylphosphinate and melamine polyphosphate, red phosphorus) and the influence of the replacement of the oil-based polyamide 6.6 with mechanical recycled polyamide on the sustainability of the production. The analysis highlighted that up to 6–9 % of environmental benefits can be achieved by replacing only 10 % of oil-based PA 6.6 with mechanical recycled PA (MRPA), with the best results for RPm given the highest percentage of PA 6.6 in the initial mixture. The results of this assessment will be useful to promote the production of EngTh more sustainably.
